entries.dialogueText: "Legally speaking, you have the authority to deploy Wruhec's Guardians to maintain order and uphold God's divine law."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus

entries.dialogueText: "As you are God's representative on earth, earthly laws are no different from godly laws, and vice versa."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must do what is necessary to re..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must do what is necessary to restore peace and order. See to it that Wruhec's Guardians are prepared for their new duties."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The sword of justice. Are you advo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sword of justice. Are you advocating for violence?"

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""I am advocating for the restoratio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am advocating for the restoration of order, so that our kingdom may continue on the path that has been ordained for it."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""As the earthly representative of G..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the earthly representative of God, you have the legal means to authorize the Guardians to use as much force as necessary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, but using them for such purpo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but using them for such purposes... It feels like a drastic measure."
